title: Incorrect `rewardType` type definition
body:
<!-- Please fill in each section completely. Thank you! -->

## Overview

<!-- Say a few words about how you came to discover this bug -->

The type definition for `Rewards["rewardType"]` doesn't seem to match the actual data coming from the RPC.

<!--
  List the steps that someone unfamiliar with your problem would
  have to take to observe this bug.

  Ideally, include a code snippet or link to a repository that
  someone can run locally to reproduce the problem.
-->
```ts
const rpcSubscriptions = createSolanaRpcSubscriptions_UNSTABLE(process.env.WS_RPC_URL!);
const abortController = new AbortController();

const blockNotifications = await rpcSubscriptions
  .blockNotifications("all", {
    commitment: "confirmed",
    transactionDetails: "none",
    maxSupportedTransactionVersion: 0,
    showRewards: true,
  })
  .subscribe({ abortSignal: abortController.signal });

for await (const notification of blockNotifications) {
  const rewards = notification.value.block?.rewards;

  if (rewards != null && rewards[0].rewardType === "Fee") { // <-- Actually works with @ts-ignore
    // Do something
  }
}
```

## Description of bug

<!--
  Describe what happened that you did not expect, or what did not
  happen the way you had hoped.

  Include the full text of error messages and logs, if any.
  Do not upload screenshots of error messages.
-->

While using `@solana/web3.js@2`, I was trying to read the `rewardsType` from a notification received from `rpcSubscriptions.blockNotifications`.

But the type definitions would only allow me to compare with `"fee"`, `"rent"`, etc, whereas the data coming from the RPC has the `rewardType` property as `"Fee"` (with a capital F).

Hence, to work around this, I have to do a `@ts-ignore` which isn't ideal. Orelse, I would get the following error,
```
This comparison appears to be unintentional because the types '"fee" | "rent" | "staking" | "voting"' and '"Fee"' have no overlap.
```
